tutorial: No FreeCAD wiki tutorial applies (OrcaSlicer is its own program). The model is the repo's own loop (orcalink/guides/orca.md, 'The loop'; tests/test_tools.py WithOrca.test_loop): two blocks made into a project, set, painted, sliced, read back, cut and sliced again, with this pass's refusals in between.

conventions.placeholders: <BOX_STL> and <TALL_STL> are full paths of two STL files the runner makes first: a 20 x 10 x 5 mm box named box.stl and an 8 x 8 x 20 mm box named tall.stl (in FreeCAD: part_primitive box size [20, 10, 5] and [8, 8, 20], then export each as STL; or orcalink.meshgen.box with orcalink.orca3mf.write_stl). No call needs a value from an earlier answer: every later call names the project by the relative path hardening.3mf.
conventions.server: These are the standalone OrcaSlicer extension's tools (mcp server 'OrcaSlicer Agent Link'). Under Agent Link for FreeCAD the same five orca tools exist with bodies; guide_read and orca_status there are Agent Link's own.
conventions.refused: An expect starting REFUSED means isError with that code and no change to the project.
conventions.ranHere: Every call that needs no OrcaSlicer was run here on the repo's sample project (the same two boxes) and gave the stated answers: settings, info sizes, set, range, part_add, gcode, instance, the paint counts 2 / 2 / 12-refused, svg 0.5 (100 layers at 0.2 here; 40 is arithmetic for 0.5), every refusal. new, arrange, the gcode slice, gcode_read of its result, the arranging after cut and orca_calibrate did not run here.

REFUSED not_found: names the topic orca

project ends hardening.3mf; objects 2 (names box.stl and tall.stl, in OrcaSlicer's order, each with index); bedType one of bedTypes; next
objects: box.stl size [20, 10, 5] with 12 triangles, tall.stl size [8, 8, 20] with 12 triangles; plates 1; filaments >= 1; sliced false; fromFile note
scope project; set.sparse_infill_density.now 25%, set.wall_loops.now 3; saved; next
REFUSED invalid_input: names the limit; the project is not saved
scope object, object tall.stl, set.wall_loops 4
effective.wall_loops 4, effective.sparse_infill_density 25%
object tall.stl; ranges has one from 5 to 10
REFUSED invalid_input: 'object is needed' and says orca_project info lists them
a modifier part added to box.stl; saved
REFUSED invalid_input: box: [x, y, z] sizes in mm
plate 1; gcodes lists the custom block at z 2
REFUSED not_allowed: M500 saves settings to the printer; force only when the person asks
box.stl has 3 instances
REFUSED invalid_input: tall.stl has 1 instance(s), cannot be split off
done arrange; objects each with a placed box (OrcaSlicer rewrote the project)
kind seam, state block, triangles 2 (the box's top)
state enforce, triangles 2, note that enforced supports need enable_support
REFUSED invalid_input: where.face is not a way to choose triangles; lists normal, box, below, above. (Before this pass it painted all 12.)
state fuzzy, triangles > 0
triangles 0, state null: the supports paint of box.stl is gone; the seam paint stays (info shows painted: [seam])
export svg, path in hardening-out, layers 40 (the 20 mm part at 0.5 mm), layerHeight 0.5; no OrcaSlicer run
REFUSED invalid_input: layerHeight 0.01 to 10 mm. (Before this pass the call ran until memory was gone.)
REFUSED invalid_input: this project has 1 plate(s)
export obj, files [one .obj in hardening-out]

gcode [paths in hardening-out], layers about 100 (20 mm at the minimal profile's 0.2 mm), filamentG > 0, time, sliced ends hardening-sliced.3mf, customGcode lists 'M117 hardening'; warnings or statistics when this build writes them; a small job: well inside one call
layers about 100, z [first, last about 20], features with Outer wall and Sparse infill, ranges, legend view feature
layer.layer 10, layer.features, layer.moves > 0; move { move 0, of, kind, from, to, line, gcode }; svg a path that exists
layer.layer is the last layer's number (clamped): read the layer field
REFUSED invalid_state: holds no G-code, orca_slice first
cut tall.stl at 12; objects 2 (tall.stl upper and lower: volumes 512 and 768 mm3); arranged true
REFUSED invalid_input: axis x, y or z
slices again with the two pieces; gcode, layers, time
project ends cal-temp.3mf, kind temperature, objects 1, howToRead names 230 °C at the bottom and 5 °C steps; built with the minimal generic printer (no profiles given)
REFUSED invalid_input: the tower's blocks are 5 °C apart

notCovered: orca_project new with bodies, orca_paint faces, replace { body }, emboss, mesh simplify / boolean, lay_flat { face }: need Agent Link for FreeCAD (a model for that side belongs with the hub's orca family)

orca_paint kind texture and the bake at slicing: need the agent-cli build's Texture Displacement and a PNG; run by hand: orca_paint { kind: texture, texture: { library: "Knurl", depth: 0.4, tileSize: 5 }, where: { normal: [0, 0, 1] } }, then orca_slice and look for textures: baked
orca_project presets / new with machine, process, filament: needs the person's own preset names
cli options (repair, ground_largest_face, align_to_y_axis …): which builds take which was not verified
the other calibration kinds: same path as temperature with other models
orca_slice export stl, stls, settings, slicedata, 3mf, inspect_mesh, inspect_paint, info: run OrcaSlicer; one call each by hand
